description: Requested by the nee_soon Xin Wang SP3 workflow (op-fr2.2.2). Deterministic consumers (GeN-Foam SP3/diffusion in outram-foam-appbuilder-lib, driven from nee_soon) need cell-homogenised multigroup macroscopic cross sections on an arbitrary user group structure: Sigma_t,g; Sigma_s,g'->g (with P1/P3 moments for SP3 D1/D2); nu*Sigma_f,g; chi_g (prompt+delayed); diffusion coeff D_g; group speeds v_g; 6-group delayed data (beta_i, lambda_i). Per Wang Eq 2.23 these are flux-weighted tallies over spatial+energy bins, normally produced by the MC transport (outram-mc op-6tz.15) but the NUCLEAR-DATA side (njoy) must expose the underlying multigroup constants / GROUPR-style capability and a public export type the coupling layer can consume. Define the public XsProvider-adjacent surface for this; implementation stays in njoy. This bead only tracks the API request from the composing crate -- prioritise per njoy roadmap.
title: Expose multigroup XS (MGXS) generation/export entry point for deterministic consumers (SP3/diffusion)

description: Unifying query 'which material is at this point?' over every random-media model. Design doc s11 specifies 'pub trait StochasticMedium { fn material_at(..) -> MaterialId }'. WORKSPACE RULE OVERRIDE: no trait-object dispatch — model as an enum StochasticMedium { Rsa | Cls | Scls } dispatched by match, with the trait kept only as a compiler-enforced contract on each concrete struct. Reuses geometry::position::Position and the existing PackedSpheres, not a new Vec3.
title: outram-mc: StochasticMedium enum dispatch abstraction (design doc s11)

description: CaseArgs (src/lib.rs) uses clap long="case" (=> --case) + short=c. OpenFOAM's convention is single-dash -case <dir>. clap parses -case as the short -c with attached value 'ase', so the OpenFOAM-style invocation fails. Affects every tool bin. Fix at the scaffold level (custom parse / allow single-dash long) so 'blockMesh -case <dir>' works. Deferred from op-x8x.1 (must not edit lib.rs).
title: CLI: -case (single-dash) OpenFOAM option not wired in CaseArgs
